messages.subject: RE: ggplot2 is not loading from win library
parts:
Hi Roman,

 

I am using ggplot2 since about 5 months now without any error on R3.4.3 accessing via Rstudio  1.1.383,

Since two days i have starting getting a error when i try to load ggplot2 irrespective of the way i use.

I tried via load package as well as library function ,without any success. Further due to “ggplot2” not loading other packages like TraMineR,ArulesViz etc. also not loading.

Tried to uninstall package and reload, tried to reinstall R and Rstudio , Tried to load via only R , non of these worked and gave the same error for any R above 3.4.0.

 

But for R below 3.4.0 , tested for R 3.3.2 , no error on trying to load ggplot2,but the problem is that i need  the TraMineR, arulesViz etc which though ggplot2 dependant don’t work in the lower versions.

 

 

 

Request your advise.

 

Thanks

 

Sudhansu
